value.answer: Call 911 now. Swelling of the lips and face, hives and a hoarse voice after peanuts is an emergency. If your child has an epinephrine auto-injector, use it right away, then keep them lying down and stay with them.
value.triage: Call 911, not Health811 (811). Don't wait to see if it passes. Antihistamines are not a substitute for epinephrine. Even if they look better, they still need the ER, because symptoms can come back.
